description: This file is a test case class for the Sdg model in a PHP project. It contains unit tests for creating, validating, associating, and deleting Sdg objects, as well as testing related entities like Category, Sphere, SocialCommitment, and Footprint.

classes.name: SdgTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for the Sdg model, containing various unit tests for CRUD operations and relationships with categories, spheres, social commitments, and footprints.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Sdg class and confirms it is an instance of Goteo\Model\Sdg.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests validation and saving of an empty Sdg object.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates an Sdg object with data, validates, saves, and verifies retrieval and property values.

methods.name: testIcon
methods.description: Tests the icon handling methods of the Sdg object, including setting and retrieving asset/link icons.

methods.name: testCategoriesRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding, replacing, removing categories related to the Sdg object.

methods.name: testSpheresRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding, replacing, removing spheres related to the Sdg object.

methods.name: testSocialCommitmentRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding, replacing, removing social commitments linked to the Sdg object.

methods.name: testFootprintRelationships
methods.description: Tests adding, replacing, removing footprints associated with the Sdg object.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Deletes the Sdg object from the database.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Verifies that once deleted, the Sdg object cannot be retrieved.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up associated entities created during tests to maintain database state.
